editorial.thesis: A trading city of about 1.5 million. Its retail is heavy on desserts, sweets & ice cream and grocery & daily needs, and thin on pharmacy & health retail and fitness & wellness — and 56% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 71% of Ranchi's. 7.16 chain outlets per lakh residents against 10.1 in Ranchi; 27 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 12, Café Coffee Day 10, Reliance Smart / Fresh 8.

The mapped economy leans to desserts & sweets. Shares of all mapped places: desserts & sweets 0.7% (Ranchi 0.4%); grocery & daily needs 1.8% (Ranchi 1.6%); healthcare 6.7% (Ranchi 10.6%); services & crafts 6.3% (Ranchi 7.3%). Raw counts would mislead because Ranchi is mapped more completely (10,516 places against 6,771), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 7 zones hold 56% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Azadnagar alone has about 201,000 residents and 30 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is less concentrated than in Ranchi. 53% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ranchi 54%). The largest cores are Bistupur Bazar · Sakchi (1,635 places) and Azadnagar (360).

The widest brand gaps against Ranchi. Reliance Smart / Fresh 8 outlets vs 16; Apollo Pharmacy 7 outlets vs 13; Reliance Digital 1 outlets vs 7. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ranchi, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Bistupur Bazar · Sakchi and Azadnagar are the largest zones by residents (279,000 and 201,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 53% of all commercial places, and Bistupur Bazar · Sakchi alone lists 1,635.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Bistupur Bazar · Sakchi holds 67 of the 108 tracked chain outlets, and Azadnagar adds 7.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Bistupur Bazar · Sakchi and Azadnagar lead on education places (193 and 86, with 71 and 27 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Azadnagar and Tatanagar. The blue cores include Bistupur Bazar · Sakchi.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (10,516 places in Ranchi against 6,771 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ranchi; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ranchi, Jamshedpur's mapped places over-index on desserts & sweets (0.7% vs 0.4%), grocery & daily needs (1.8% vs 1.6%), other services (8.6% vs 7.8%) and under-index on healthcare (6.7% vs 10.6%), services & crafts (6.3% vs 7.3%), automotive (4.3% vs 4.9%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 108 outlets of 27 tracked national brands within 8 km — 7.16 per lakh residents against Ranchi's 10.1 (167 outlets of 29 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ranchi are Reliance Smart / Fresh (8 vs 16); Apollo Pharmacy (7 vs 13); Reliance Digital (1 vs 7). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ranchi's, so low means thin by Ranchi's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Jamshedpur's age mix against Ranchi: children (0–14) 27.0% vs 27.2%, 15–24 18.7% vs 19.7%, working age 46.1% vs 45.7%, 60+ 8.2% vs 7.3%. Under-25s are 46% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.3% of mapped places against 5.3% in Ranchi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 12 (Ranchi 16), Pizza Hut 5 (Ranchi 6), KFC 3 (Ranchi 5), Wow! Momo 3 (Ranchi 4). No mapped outlet in either city: Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.6% of mapped places against 1.8% in Ranchi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 10 (Ranchi 7), Starbucks 1 (Ranchi 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.7% of mapped places against 0.4% in Ranchi — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 4 (Ranchi 5). No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Naturals, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.9% of mapped places against 1.6% in Ranchi — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 8 (Ranchi 16), Vishal Mega Mart 3 (Ranchi 8), Spencer's 1 (Ranchi 0). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.4% of mapped places against 1.7% in Ranchi — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 7 (Ranchi 13). No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 5.5% of mapped places against 5.0% in Ranchi — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 8 (Ranchi 10), Raymond 8 (Ranchi 12), Bata 8 (Ranchi 12), Titan 6 (Ranchi 11). No mapped outlet in either city: Zudio, Max Fashion, Lifestyle.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.4% of mapped places against 7.7% in Ranchi, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.6% of mapped places against 3.8% in Ranchi, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.9% of mapped places against 4.6% in Ranchi — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
